directions.name: Container 5 — Wandering ink
directions.style: FAMILY 5: HAND-DRAWN COLOUR SHAPES WITH A SPARE WANDERING INK EDGE. Six new broad spontaneous irregular panel silhouettes, each drawn with a few relaxed turns, flattened corners and uneven gently curving sides. Add a thin loose Story Ink line tracing most of the outer edge; the line is humanly imprecise, occasionally breaks and drifts just outside the fill, with one or two tiny overshoots at corners. Do not add a neat uniform border or a second full line. Filled areas keep exact master colours. Wide cream panel a crooked freehand quadrilateral with softened corners; blue panel a tall uneven bag-like abstract block without any literal handle or object details; yellow tile a lopsided 5-sided rounded mass; lavender banner slightly sloping, one long bowed side; tan panel has a shallow inward curve on one shoulder; red callout a broad asymmetrical oval-block hybrid. Small accents use confident slightly wobbling strokes and similarly partial thin ink contour. Raw thoughtful human drawing, not childishly messy or densely scribbled. No surface hatching, no extra colours.

directions.name: Container 6 — Torn contours
directions.style: FAMILY 6: ABSTRACT HAND-TORN EDGE SILHOUETTES, ENTIRELY FLAT COLOUR. Broad irregular panels with organically torn outer contours: coarse shallow angular changes, uneven nibbled corners, a few long imperfect straight stretches interrupted by small ragged deviations. The torn quality must be in the perimeter only, not paper surface, white fibres, shadows or layered collage. Strong simple large-scale silhouette with a smaller natural roughness at the edge. Six clearly different torn polygon shapes: uneven landscape quadrilateral; tall blue torn slab with a tilted shoulder; yellow broad pentagonal soft mass; long lavender strip with asymmetrical raw ends; tan panel with one shallow torn corner recess; red wide block with an oblique rounded-off end. Central content area stays broad and clean. Small accents use the same slightly ragged edges: angular freehand squiggle, imperfect torn pebble, irregular loop, uneven broad burst, kinked strip, lopsided arch. Modern cheerful hand-torn craft, no brown cardboard, no material rendering, no paint texture or decorative outlines.

directions.name: Container 7 — Marker gestures
directions.style: FAMILY 7: FAT MARKER GESTURES BECOMING FILLED PANELS. Broad freehand masses drawn in a single confident wrist movement, visible in contour rhythm rather than pigment texture. Uneven hand pressure changes the outer silhouette: thick rounded shoulders, blunt slightly flattened stroke ends, little dips where a gesture turns, occasional expressive corner hooks that stay outside the content centre. All fills uniform master colours. Cream landscape container a broad low loop-like mass with NO hole and one flattened side; blue tall mass has a domed off-axis shoulder and a blunt bottom edge; yellow tile a gently pinched irregular rounded pentagon; lavender banner a very broad sweeping stroke with low-slung upper edge and mismatched ends; tan container an asymmetrical soft block with one short flattened corner; red callout a generous broad swash-like slab with a blunt diagonal end. No thin appendages, no speech-bubble tails, no holes, no painted scribble interiors. Small accents are fluid pressure-varied marker marks with softly irregular edges. No outlines, no jagged paper edges, no repeated cloud lobes, no gradients or brush texture. Visibly freehand and much more spontaneous than the previous polished panels.

directions.name: Container 8 — Bold scissor shapes
directions.style: FAMILY 8: BOLD NAIVE SCISSOR-CUT ASYMMETRY. Chunky broad planar silhouettes with unexpected clipped angles, slanted long edges, one or two big concave bites and strongly unequal corner shapes. Use deliberate but freehand cuts, not mechanically rounded geometry. Each panel is one stable spacious filled piece. Cream landscape shape is a broad six-sided card with off-axis angled top and one blunt projecting corner; blue tall card a generous crooked trapezoid with one gentle scooped shoulder; yellow square tile has one off-centre broad chamfer and a bulged opposite side; lavender banner has irregular oblique cut ends and one broad shallow step; tan card an asymmetrical broad polygon with a single curved cut corner; red callout a chunky squat shape with two broad soft points at one end, never a literal arrow or pennant. Keep clear space for content, no narrow waists or huge cutouts. Small abstract accents are playful bold wedges and bent cuts interpreting the same fixed six accent categories. Simple startling silhouette, raw confident visual energy, no thin outline, no ragged torn fibres, no texture, no symmetry and no tiny repetitive cuts.
